title: Text completions gained a tier label
summary:
A quiet week of making Pollinations easier to explore and text API responses easier to understand.

Completion responses gained a `user_tier` field showing the authenticated tier or `anonymous`. Tier is also recorded in event tracking and displayed by the model-name discovery script, making it easier to see which tier a result belongs to.

Contributor guidance added Sequa AI’s Pollinations codebase-knowledge MCP endpoint, giving people with an MCP client another way to explore the project.

The project catalog added websim-pollinations-ai and Visiora, the website gained a direct projects anchor and listed NavyAI and Nebius as supporters. The Claude workflow switched to Sequa’s web-search tool, and the separate automated Claude PR-review workflow was removed.
